headline: 123 Get The Haaland Reassurance
deck: Norway say Haaland, owned by 123, is unbothered by the Man City verdict
body:
The noise around City reached Norway, and Haaland's colleagues there report a man untouched by it. For 123 that is the only line that matters. The cornerstone of the squad plays on, a City verdict overhead and a striker who, by every account around the camp, has not so much as blinked at it.

What it does to 123's returns is unwritten. The Wales fixture comes first, the asset is fit and present, and the headlines stay headlines. Nothing here moves him.
